name: COMP_006
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (45%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Invasive is close behind (42%), and the image is flagged as atypical [F6].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 45%, Invasive 42%, Benign 11%, Normal 3% | Near tie |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive | Three classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.48 / OOD percentile 1.0 | Input flagged suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Neighbors support InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Largest positive concept association [F3] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · High score in the same regions · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 2, 3) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical; spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 1, 5, 6) · ↑ invasive · Weak positive association; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Points away from invasion; single region · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cut the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. This case leans on Unreliable mitoses and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- The image is out of distribution (reliability 0.48), so every score may be shifted.
- Invasion in regions 0, 2, 3 is real, making Invasive the better call.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 2, 3:** Confirm stromal invasion and pleomorphism; verify mitoses directly.
2. **Region 10:** Check whether atypical cells stay confined within ducts.
3. **Regions 1, 5, 6:** Confirm whether necrosis is actually present.
